card.statement:
[Theorem <<ref:thm:ns gen>>] Let $V$ be a simple $\Ymn$-module of the form

\[
L_{h^{(1)}}(\la^{(1)})\otimes L_{h^{(2)}}(\la^{(2)})\otimes\cdots\otimes L_{h^{(k)}}(\la^{(k)}),
\]

where each $L_{h^{(a)}}(\la^{(a)})$ is a covariant evaluation module. Then $d_i(u)$ ($1\leq i\leq m+n$) acts semisimply on $V$ if and only if it is of the form

\[
V_{\underline{h}^{(1)}}(\underline{\la}^{(1)})\otimes\cdots\otimes V_{\underline{h}^{(N)}}(\underline{\la}^{(N)}),
\]

up to an automorphism, where each $\underline{h}^{(a)}=(h^{(a_1)},\ldots,h^{(a_{M_a})})$ belongs to $\BC^{M_a}$ with $h^{(a_i)}-h^{(a_j)}\in\BZ$ for all $1\leq i,j\leq M_a$ and the differences between elements in $\underline{h}^{(a)}$ and $\underline{h}^{(b)}$ are not integers for $1\leq a\neq b\leq N$, in addition, each $(\underline{h}^{(a)},\underline{\la}^{(a)})$ is a strong non-crossing collection of covariant weight.
card.label: Theorem 1

paper.title: Representations of Super Yangians with Gelfand-Tsetlin bases
paper.abstract: The evaluation homomorphism from the super Yangian $\mathrm Y(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$ to the universal enveloping algebra $\mathrm U(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$ allows one to regard the $\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n}$-modules as $\mathrm Y(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$-modules. In this paper, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for simple tensor products of covariant evaluation modules to be tame. We also provide an explicit construction of Gelfand-Tsetlin bases for tensor products of skew modules.
